entries.30abcf88d4c2cfc1: The act of an architect, on their own responsibility, checking construction work against the design documents to confirm that it is carried out as the design documents specify.
entries.95f1d1a8f8ff6f18: The act of an architect, on their own responsibility, checking construction work against the design documents to confirm that it is carried out as the design documents specify. It is a different job from "construction management (sekō kanri)," which advances the work on site.
